adoptedRules: 기존 LRC·ACK SeqNo·문자 인코딩·비부호 정수·논리 분할 기준
표준 데이터 우선, 설계서 Belt 구조로 자동 변환하지 않음
돌발상황은 설계서 Server/Client 표 적용, 재접속 문장 모순 보존
connectionScope: one TCP connection per selected test item
exchangeInitiation: provider push; no separate information-request frame defined for messages 67..72
repeatCount: repetitions per item; heartbeat uses heartbeat_samples; preparation and fragment repair are not extra completed exchanges
sequenceScope: continuous across rounds within a session, modulo 256
changePreparation: one baseline exchange before N changing information exchanges
fragmentRejectionRecovery: bad_sequence supplementary test: NACK for invalid End, corrected End at expected sequence, ACK, then next round on the same connection; adopted test procedure
